data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Wire the story branch scripts into sprint Phase E, Phase F, and validate.sh.

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (Phase E and Phase F sections)
- plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh (add check-session-branch-invariant.sh call)

## Acceptance Criteria (from DD3, DD4, DD5-renumbered)

### SKILL.md Phase E (DD3)
After marking story in-progress, before task dispatch, add:
```bash
STORY_BRANCH=$(bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/create-story-branch.sh" "$EPIC_ID" "$STORY_ID")
```
STORY_BRANCH is captured in orchestrator variable — used later by Phase F.

### SKILL.md Phase F (DD4)
After all worktrees for story are harvested, before story closure, add:
1. Conflict-queue in-memory check (using existing CONFLICT_QUEUE array pattern):
```bash
if [[ ${#CONFLICT_QUEUE[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo 'ERROR: conflict queue non-empty — resolve conflicts before merging story branch' >&2
  exit 1
fi
```
2. Then call merge-story-branch.sh:
```bash
bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/merge-story-branch.sh" "$STORY_BRANCH" "$STORY_ID"
```

### validate.sh (DD5-renumbered)
Add call to check-session-branch-invariant.sh following existing pattern (existence-guard):
```bash
if [ -f "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/check-session-branch-invariant.sh" ]; then
  bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/check-session-branch-invariant.sh"
fi
```

## Notes
- per-worktree-review-commit.md does NOT need modification — sub-agents only call harvest-worktree.sh; Phase F orchestrator calls merge-story-branch.sh after sub-agents complete
- check-sprint-trailer.sh does NOT need modification — it only fires on task commits in story worktrees, not on session-branch merge commits
data.title: UPDATE: SKILL.md Phase E/F + validate.sh — wire story branch lifecycle
